directions: Suppose your university student union is planning to hold a speech contest. You are now to write a proposal for organizing the contest. The proposal may include the topic, aim , procedure and selection of contestants. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least且Q words but no more than垃Q words.
sample_essay:
To ensure the successful organization of the upcoming speech contest, I would like to put forward the following proposal.

To begin with, the topic of the speech contest could be "The Power of Dreams". This topic is relevant to students' lives and can inspire them to express their aspirations. The aim of the contest is to enhance students' public-speaking skills and encourage them to think about their future. 

In addition, the procedure of the contest can be divided into two rounds. In the first round, all contestants will give a 3-minute speech. A panel of judges will select the top 10 contestants to enter the second round. In the second round, the finalists will have a 5-minute speech and answer some questions from the judges. 

Furthermore, the selection of contestants can be open to all students in the university. Students can sign up either individually or be recommended by their departments. 

In conclusion, this well-planned speech contest with a meaningful topic, clear procedure and fair selection method will surely attract many students and achieve the expected results.
